statement: Between 2026-08-14 and 2026-09-18, CISA adds at least one Microsoft SharePoint Server CVE to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog JSON contains an entry with vendorProject Microsoft and a product string naming SharePoint, carrying a dateAdded value between 2026-08-14 and 2026-09-18 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry naming SharePoint carries a dateAdded value inside the window.

statement: Between 2026-08-14 and 2026-11-13, a putative class action arising from the Trezor customer data breach is filed in a United States federal district court.
resolution: A PACER or CourtListener docket shows a civil class action complaint naming Trezor or SatoshiLabs as defendant over the disclosed breach, with a filing date inside the window.
failure_condition: No such complaint carries a US federal district court filing date inside the window.

statement: WTI front-month crude settles at or above 95.00 dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-08-17 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: The CME NYMEX Light Sweet Crude Oil front-month contract posts a settlement price of 95.00 or higher on any trading day from 2026-08-17 through 2026-09-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: Every front-month WTI settlement inside the window prints below 95.00 dollars.

statement: The Treasury 10-year constant maturity par yield closes at or below 4.25 percent on at least one business day between 2026-08-17 and 2026-11-04.
resolution: The Treasury daily par yield curve 10-year constant maturity, equivalently FRED series DGS10, records a value at or below 4.25 on any business day inside the window.
failure_condition: DGS10 prints above 4.25 on every business day inside the window.

statement: Between 2026-08-17 and 2026-09-27, Ukrainian forces strike a Russian Black Sea port, oil terminal, or grain terminal, and both sides acknowledge the strike.
resolution: A Russian regional governor or the Russian Defence Ministry and a Ukrainian military or intelligence source each describe a strike on a Russian Black Sea port facility occurring inside the window, carried by Reuters or AFP.
failure_condition: No strike on a Russian Black Sea port facility inside the window draws acknowledgement from both a Russian and a Ukrainian official source.

statement: Between 2026-08-17 and 2026-09-20, Iranian forces seize, board, or detain at least one commercial vessel in the Strait of Hormuz or the Gulf of Oman.
resolution: UKMTO issues an incident advisory and Reuters or Lloyds List reports an Iranian seizure, boarding, or detention of a commercial vessel in those waters occurring inside the window.
failure_condition: No Iranian seizure, boarding, or detention of a commercial vessel occurs in those waters inside the window.

statement: A named successor to Karoline Leavitt as White House press secretary is publicly announced between 2026-08-14 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: The White House or the President names a specific individual as press secretary or acting press secretary inside the window, reported by both the Associated Press and Reuters.
failure_condition: No individual is named to the press secretary post inside the window.

statement: The Electoral Commission of Zambia declares the incumbent president the winner of the 2026 general election, with the declaration made between 2026-08-13 and 2026-08-21.
resolution: An official ECZ declaration issued inside the window names the sitting president as winner, carried by Reuters and BBC News.
failure_condition: The ECZ declares a challenger the winner, or issues no presidential declaration, inside the window.

statement: USGS records at least one magnitude 6.0 or greater earthquake within 250 km of the epicenter of event us6000tjl2, with origin time between 2026-08-17 and 2026-09-14.
resolution: A USGS ComCat query returns one or more events of magnitude 6.0 or above within 250 km of the us6000tjl2 epicenter with origin time inside the window.
failure_condition: ComCat returns no magnitude 6.0 or greater event meeting both the distance and origin-time criteria.

statement: Tropical cyclone ONE-C of the 2026 Central Pacific season is carried at hurricane strength, 64 knots or greater, in an advisory issued between 2026-08-13 and 2026-08-22.
resolution: A Central Pacific Hurricane Center public advisory or the NHC advisory archive lists maximum sustained winds of 64 knots or higher for this system at an advisory time inside the window.
failure_condition: Every advisory issued for the system inside the window lists maximum sustained winds below 64 knots.
